name: Generic Cabin Safety Demo
description: Deterministic synthetic reference profile for the MultiSens v0.4 requirement-coverage workflow. SYNTHETIC DATA - demonstrates functionality only, not a regulatory framework and not a claim about real sensor performance. See examples/profiles/README.md.

requirements.name: Day baseline
requirements.description: Baseline presence accuracy in daylight with a clear (unoccluded) view.

requirements.name: Night baseline
requirements.description: Baseline presence accuracy at night with a clear (unoccluded) view.

requirements.name: Day, partial occlusion
requirements.description: Presence accuracy in daylight with partial occlusion of the sensor's view.

requirements.name: Night, partial occlusion
requirements.description: Presence accuracy at night with partial occlusion of the sensor's view - the hardest single-dimension case in this demo.

requirements.name: Strict day accuracy
requirements.description: A stricter accuracy bar under the same daylight/clear-view conditions as the Alertness baseline - demonstrates that the same evidence can satisfy one requirement and fail another; acceptance is requirement-specific, not a property of the configuration alone.

requirements.name: Strict night accuracy
requirements.description: A stricter accuracy bar under the same night/clear-view conditions as the Alertness baseline.
